text: The gate never builds the release variant or the wheel, and the web_dist glob is one level deep

Landed in d772473. The gate now runs :app:testReleaseUnitTest (the release-variant proof android/README.md names) and a wheel-build + smoke-test stage, so a packaging regression no longer waits for a release run; web_dist package data is recursive; the web stage calls node_modules/.bin directly instead of npx; build-wheel uses --no-build-isolation with setuptools pinned, and the lint toolchain is pinned; bootstrap.sh checksums the cmdline-tools download (checksum verified against a real download, not model-generated) and fails on a bad unzip; the README no longer claims a release wheel needs only Python. Skipped with reasons: a fully offline smoke-wheel and a separate build extras group.
